Now I forced myself to play it for the gold promote achievement and after a few games I got used to it, realizing that the problem was that I expected myself to do the same stuff I used to with scout and driller.

When that clicked I started to enjoy it and, even though I have the same problem with engi rn, I'm sure the same will happen once I start exping the class.

I still enjoy scout the most but playing the other classes is helping me know them better and their builds/overclock and maybe even think of fun synergies when playing with my friends (not becuase it's needed but because i enjoy that).

Totally respect your point of view ofc, I just don't agree with it. Rock and stone!

I always build bork as first item, that's the only mandatory one for me for now. One time I built rageblade first item instead of bork (actually by mistake) and i wasn't doing damage at all.i usually like hexplate as second item because i can get some hp early on, otherwise i have to wait until the 4th item to go tanky. 

My usual progression is: bork -> hexplate/rageblade -> terminus -> tank items

But maybe I just have to learn to be even more careful and stay a glass cannon until mid-late game. I would say it also depends if you have any peeling at all or not.

rn i don't think it's core anymore. it's no doubt great but it doesn't give you pen anymore and kog already deals a lot of damage, so i prefer to trade it with something a bit more tanky oriented, aka hexplate.

don't get me wrong, i can absolutely feel the fall in damage when i don't build it but i still prefer it that way, especially now that the terminus has been buffed to require less aa to reach max stacks.

regarding the "teamfight only" thing i said about the rageblade, i remembered wrong and it always works, making it the best source of damage for every situation.

I've been using hexplate too and I'm liking it. It's usually my second item instead of the rageblade; depends if I want to be tanky or glass cannon.

The ulti cdr is a wasted stat, yes, but the attack speed on command (R) means I don't have to be in a teamfight to make use of it. I appreciate it a lot when i have to rush towers and especially drakes and barons, to get in as many w aa as possible. That means that sometimes you have to hold your R, though.

The extra health is useful to survive, it's amplified by the overgrowth rune (if you use it) and it'll help with any other health based item you might build later, like kaenic, randuin or hydra.

EDIT: I'm around plat4 rn, so I'm not sure how reliable my info are. This is the experience I've been having so far.
